summary: Add the read-only `top-posts` composite command that ranks the authenticated user's recent posts by engagement (or a chosen public metric).
reason: Composes the existing /2/users/me and user-timeline reads into a single ranked leaderboard so an agent can answer 'which of my recent posts performed best' without manual pagination and sorting; no new HTTP surface and no writes.
validated_outcome: Go build, vet, and tests pass without live X calls; synthetic HTTP tests cover explicit ID reads, empty intermediate pages, repeated tokens, and structured metric labels. Missing impressions remain distinct from measured zero, large fetches are bounded, sparse-page budget hits retain a marked partial leaderboard, and dry-run emits nothing.
